title: Spex Workspace Config
description: Workspace configuration (spex.yaml): the project and the workspace repositories that spex manages together.

cli_version.description: Semantic version (MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH) of the spex CLI that wrote this config. spex warns on a mismatch with the installed CLI; run `spex update` to sync.

description.description: Optional summary of what the project is and does.

rs_specs_removed.description: Rule spec IDs deliberately removed from this workspace's `rs-specs/`. `spex update` respects a listed ID by never redeploying its bundled template; any bundled rs-spec missing locally but not listed here is treated as newly available upstream and gets deployed.

repositories.description: Workspace repositories that spex manages for this project.

repository_name.description: Full kebab-case name of the repository, `<project-name>-<repository-short-name>` (for example `pepperoni-pizza-api`). Matches the repository directory name per RS-NAMING-CONVENTION.

repository_short_name.description: Kebab-case name of the repository excluding the project name (for example `api`). Used to derive cross-cutting identifiers in RS-NAMING-CONVENTION.

description.description: Optional summary of what the repository is and does.

path.description: Path to the repository, relative to the spex directory.

contracts.description: Machine-readable interface contracts this repository owns. Each entry points at a contract file wherever it lives (typically inside this repository's own directory; the spex repository's `contracts/` folder is only a convention for contracts shared across repositories) and summarizes it.

rs_specs.description: Rule spec IDs (RS) that apply to this repository.

checks_preexisting_errors.description: Baseline of pre-existing `error`-severity findings to suppress for this repository, so a check can be enforced going forward without first fixing every existing violation. Each entry names the check by `spec` + `check`; an `error` finding from that check is dropped when its location file is listed in `files` (or always, when `files` is omitted or empty). New errors in other files still surface, and `warn`-severity findings are never affected.

contract.description: A machine-readable interface contract (OpenAPI, proto, GraphQL SDL, AsyncAPI) owned by a repository.

path.description: Path to the contract file, relative to the spex directory (for example `../pepperoni-pizza-api/contracts/api.openapi.yaml` when the contract lives in the owning repository, or `contracts/api.openapi.yaml` when it lives in the spex repository's shared `contracts/` folder).

description.description: Short summary of what the contract covers (for example `admin rest openapi spec`).

preexisting_error.description: A baseline entry that suppresses pre-existing `error`-severity findings for one check.

spec.description: Rule spec ID of the check whose pre-existing errors are baselined. Must be one of the repository's rs_specs.

check.description: Name of the check whose pre-existing errors are baselined.

files.description: Repository-relative files whose pre-existing errors are suppressed. Omit or leave empty to suppress the whole check. A regexp finding's `file:line` location is matched on its file part.

contracts.description: REST OpenAPI spec for the orders API.

repositories.description: React web client that lets customers place orders.
